name: RUPBench
description: RUPBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the robustness of large language models across diverse reasoning tasks under various textual perturbations at lexical, syntactic, and semantic levels.
reputation: A newer robustness benchmark that is useful for stress-testing LLM reasoning under perturbations, but it is not yet as widely adopted as major general-purpose benchmarks.
notes: Includes 15 reasoning datasets with 9 types of textual perturbations to test robustness; analyzes error patterns and model size impact.
